text: CIFTI development is isolated in /work/code/neuroatlas-cifti on feat/cifti-mixed-transforms, based on bfc6ed5. RNifti + optional xml2 was approved by the owner. Dense scalar/label transport passes 17 independent NiBabel fixtures, including both axis orders, singleton maps, endianness and scaling. The cortical-only mixed adapter passes eight full-density cases in both fsaverage164k/fsLR32k directions and both hemispheres: 2,874,376 values, zero value/availability mismatches against direct public surface application; NiBabel validates all written outputs. Existing noncortical support/geometry is preserved by index in an explicitly declared common MNI6/MNI2009c frame; changed volume frames/grids/support are rejected. Workbench inspects all fixtures but classifies transposed matrix axes as an unknown subtype. No new Workbench numerical parity, anatomical, inverse or conservation claim. Source-bound compact receipts and retained failures are under data-raw/cifti-v1/qualification/devbox-20261007. Project lint passes; full development tests, package/manual check and website build are running. Broad coverage issue remains open for densities, subcortical warping, backprojection, CIVET and specialist templates.
